newsitem.title: USA: Resort Income Investors assets decrease.
newsitem.headline: Resort Income Investors assets decrease.

text.p: Resort Income Investors Inc, reporting on its self-liquidation during the third quarter, said net assets in liquidation decreased to $5.8 million from $11.7 million.

Chairman John Young said the decrease was due mainly to the company's recognition of an allowance for impairment in loans and accrued interest in the amount of $5.5 million regarding its loan collateralized by property in Saint Maarten.

As a result of uncertainty caused by various lawsuits brought against the company and certain current and former officers, and writedowns it has taken, Resort Income Investors will not make any further liquidating distributions. But it will regularly reevaluate its positon.
The company, incorporated in 1988 as a 12-year self-liquidating real estate trust, made mortgage loans secured by gaming related developments.
